items.q: But Art Blackey at this time, one night, came up to me with an idea of doing some booking of -- we were going to -- we got a little corporation called Three O'clock High.

ctx.x: Yes, but when I joined Nat I was with Art Tatum. Which I'm going to get to again. So I worked at

Birdland with Art Tatum, and also played on the same bill as Ella Fitzgerald. I worked with her there. But Art Blackey at this time, one night, came up to me with an idea of doing some booking of -- we were going to -- we got a little corporation called Three O'clock High. Now, this --
What was the significance of the name?
